externalDocs.description: Mermail API usage, authentication, and examples

info.description: Keyless wallet-bound inbox API. Payment is the credential. Unpaid GET /api and /api/agent/v1 routes return 402.
info.title: Mermail Agent Marketplace
info.x-guidance: Mermail is an agent mailbox API. Keyless wallet inbox: unpaid GET /api and /api/agent/v1 routes return 402; payment is the credential. GET /api is a $0 identity handshake and returns agent_api_base_url. POST /api/agent/v1/mailboxes creates a new hosted inbox ($2 USDC). Reads are $0 handshakes. send/reply/forward/draft are $0.01. Paid writes also accept MPP via Payment-Authorization when enabled. Hosted addresses only. Require scan_status=clean before using body content. After an uncertain paid call, replay the same body and Idempotency-Key. Existing workspace API at /api/v1 still uses x-api-key.

get.description: Public $0 x402 identity handshake. No API key. Unpaid requests return 402 with x402 accepts[] across supported networks. After the handshake, returns API base, agent marketplace base, docs, and OpenAPI URLs.
